method.teacher_system: The teacher demonstrates full movement sequences, breaks down individual body isolations (legs, hips, chest, head) step-by-step, and combines them into routines with slow-motion repetitions.
method.signature: combining isolation breakdowns with fluid freestyle demonstrations and specific mechanical tips for each body part

practices.what: demonstrates the basic double leg roll by bending knees and rolling forward on toes
breaks down single leg rolls with wider foot placement for better isolation
teaches hip rolls by isolating upper body and moving hips side to side in a circle
teaches boogaloo chest isolations by moving the chest forward, back, and side to side
introduces head rolls combined with body and chest movements
breaks down the old man move by shifting weight between upper and lower body diagonally

adaptations.difficulty: losing isolation when legs are too wide
adaptations.adjustment: do not go too wide, keep feet at a moderate distance

adaptations.difficulty: doing upper and lower body rolls in both ways at first
adaptations.adjustment: you are probably not going to be able to do this both ways at first; you probably won't get this move for a few days

beliefs.belief: Messing up is what makes an advanced dancer; making mistakes is part of learning this freestyle dance.

moments.says: The teacher introduces the foundational concept of Boogaloo by demonstrating a short sequence to set the stage for learning.
The teacher defines isolation and explains how to keep the upper body steady while rolling.
The teacher demonstrates why going too wide causes a loss of isolation and shows how to fix it.
The teacher warns that the move is difficult and reassures the learner that it takes a few days to get.
The teacher encourages the learner to keep trying, messing up, and practicing rolls and isolations.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling encouraged to embrace mistakes as a natural part of mastering freestyle dance.

struggles.theme: Stiff when trying to do the moves
Chest boog is the hardest move

meant.theme: Best popping teacher on YouTube and great inspiration

method.limits: audio is mostly background music with voiceover narration rather than live sync instructions
